name: Printful
label: Printful API v2 (Open Beta) — orders, files, rates
description: Printful API v2 Open Beta at api.printful.com/v2. Bearer private token. X-PF-Store-Id from config store_id when set (required for account-level tokens). sync_product stays on v1 POST /store/products — store product sync is not in v2 yet. Artwork via file ref-id / URL, never inline bytes. Customer warrants IP rights. Docs: https://developers.printful.com/docs/v2-beta/
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One official API operation. Secrets stay in configurationParameters.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Official API verb. EXACT: sync_product | order_create | order_get | file_upload | shipping_rates | trigger. Blank uses configurationParameters.operation. v2 Open Beta except sync_product (v1). trigger is ingress (BPMN message event), not an HTTP call.

schema.label: id
schema.description: Resource id for get/update/delete path {id} when that operation needs it.

schema.label: sync_product
schema.description: v1 POST /store/products sync_product object. Required name. Example: {"name":"Tee"}. sync_product only.

schema.label: sync_variants
schema.description: v1 sync_variants array (variant_id, retail_price, files). sync_product. Example: [{"variant_id":4011,"retail_price":"24.00"}].

schema.label: recipient
schema.description: v2 order/shipping recipient. Required keys: name, address1, city, country_code, zip. Also state_code, email, phone. order_create and shipping_rates. Example: {"name":"Ada","address1":"1 Market","city":"San Francisco","country_code":"US","zip":"94105"}.

schema.label: order_items
schema.description: v2 order items [{source, catalog_variant_id, quantity, placements}]. order_create and shipping_rates. Example: [{"source":"catalog","catalog_variant_id":4012,"quantity":1}].

schema.label: items
schema.description: Alias of order_items kept for existing workflows. Prefer order_items.

schema.label: external_id
schema.description: Merchant order id for order_create. Example: ORD-1001.

schema.label: shipping
schema.description: Shipping method for order_create. Common: STANDARD | EXPRESS. Example: STANDARD.

schema.label: role
schema.description: file_upload file role. Common: printfile | preview | label. Example: printfile.

ports.name: output
ports.description: status=ok + data on 2xx. Secrets never present. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Provider HTTP status. Never includes secrets.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body. May contain order PII — do not log values.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: HTTP verb for OfficialApiNode. EXACT: sync_product | order_create | order_get | file_upload | shipping_rates | trigger. sync_product is v1; others are v2 Open Beta. trigger does not open a socket.

configurationParameters.label: Api Token
configurationParameters.description: StudioQuack secret. Auth type bearer. Never log. Customer owns the merchant account.

configurationParameters.label: Store Id
configurationParameters.description: X-PF-Store-Id for account-level tokens. Sent via extraHeaders when set; omitted when blank.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout seconds (connect + read). <=0 uses api_spec defaultTimeout.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
